name: Meagre
description: Meagre (Argyrosomus regius) - a big coastal drum famous for its croaking chorus, targeted by the Imraguen artisanal fishers of the Banc and by foreign fleets. Life-stage group of the source's adult and juvenile meagre compartments, measured separately (adults hunt fish and cephalopods, juveniles add zooplankton) and pooled here because the two stanzas form one population.
